preconditions.description: The number of elements n is between 3 and 10^5 inclusive.
The list of numbers contains exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in nums)
preconditions.description: Each number in the input list is an integer between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if the numbers can be arranged in a circle such that adjacent elements differ by exactly 1, otherwise 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: can_form_circle(nums) == (len(set(nums)) <= 2 and (len(set(nums)) == 1 or (max(nums) - min(nums) == 1 and nums.count(min(nums)) == nums.count(max(nums)))))
postconditions.description: A valid circular arrangement exists if and only if: (1) there is only one unique value, or (2) there are exactly two unique values differing by 1, and the counts of the minimum and maximum values are equal.
